versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés no monte Sinai, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֤י תָבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְשָׁבְתָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra que eu vos dou, a terra fará sábado ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ תִּזְרַ֣ע שָׂדֶ֔ךָ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְמֹ֣ר כַּרְמֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
controles.kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
controles.livre: Seis anos semearás tua terra, e seis anos podarás tua vinha, e colherás seus frutos;

versos.hebraico: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ת שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָ֑ה שָֽׂדְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔ע וְכַרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִזְמֹֽר׃

controles.web: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
controles.kjv: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
controles.livre: E no sétimo ano a terra terá sábado de descanso, sábado ao SENHOR: não semearás tua terra, nem podarás tua vinha.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ת סְפִ֤יחַ קְצִֽירְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־עִנְּבֵ֥י נְזִירֶ֖ךָ לֹ֣א תִבְצֹ֑ר שְׁנַ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
controles.kjv: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
controles.livre: O que de seu se nascer em tua terra ceifada, não o ceifarás; e as uvas de teu vinhedo não vindimarás: ano de descanso será à terra.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠הָיְתָה שַׁבַּ֨ת הָאָ֤רֶץ לָכֶם֙ לְאָכְלָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וְלַאֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְלִשְׂכִֽירְךָ֙ וּלְתוֹשָׁ֣בְךָ֔ הַגָּרִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
controles.kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
controles.livre: Mas o sábado da terra vos será para comer a ti, e a teu servo, e a tua serva, e a tua criado, e a tua estrangeiro que morar contigo:

versos.hebraico: וְלִ֨בְהֶמְתְּךָ֔ וְלַֽחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ תִּהְיֶ֥ה כָל־תְּבוּאָתָ֖הּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃ס

controles.web: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
controles.kjv: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
controles.livre: E a teu animal, e à animal que houver em tua terra, será todo o fruto dela para comer.

versos.hebraico: וְסָפַרְתָּ֣ לְךָ֗ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת שָׁנִ֔ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהָי֣וּ לְךָ֗ יְמֵי֙ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תֵּ֥שַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
controles.livre: E te hás de contar sete semanas de anos, sete vezes sete anos; de modo que os dias das sete semanas de anos virão a ser para ti quarenta e nove anos.

versos.hebraico: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֞ שׁוֹפַ֤ר תְּרוּעָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּיוֹם֙ הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּכָל־אַרְצְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
controles.livre: Então farás passar a trombeta de júbilo no mês sétimo aos dez do mês; o dia da expiação fareis passar a trombeta por toda vossa terra.

versos.hebraico: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּ֗ם אֵ֣ת שְׁנַ֤ת הַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּקְרָאתֶ֥ם דְּר֛וֹר בָּאָ֖רֶץ לְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ יוֹבֵ֥ל הִוא֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ תָּשֻֽׁבוּ׃

controles.web: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
controles.kjv: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
controles.livre: E santificareis o ano cinquenta, e apregoareis liberdade na terra a todos os seus moradores: este vos será jubileu; e voltareis cada um à sua possessão, e cada qual voltará à sua família.

versos.hebraico: יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֗וא שְׁנַ֛ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔עוּ וְלֹ֤א תִקְצְרוּ֙ אֶת־סְפִיחֶ֔יהָ וְלֹ֥א תִבְצְר֖וּ אֶת־נְזִרֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
controles.kjv: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
controles.livre: O ano dos cinquenta anos vos será jubileu: não semeareis, nem colhereis o que nascer de seu na terra, nem vindimareis seus vinhedos:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֔וא קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִן־הַ֨שָּׂדֶ֔ה תֹּאכְל֖וּ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
controles.kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
controles.livre: Porque é jubileu: santo será a vós; o produto da terra comereis.

versos.hebraico: בִּשְׁנַ֥ת הַיּוֹבֵ֖ל הַזֹּ֑את תָּשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
controles.kjv: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
controles.livre: Em este ano de jubileu voltareis cada um à sua possessão.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־תִמְכְּר֤וּ מִמְכָּר֙ לַעֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ א֥וֹ קָנֹ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ אַל־תּוֹנ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
controles.kjv: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
controles.livre: E quando venderdes algo a vosso próximo, ou comprardes da mão de vosso próximo, não engane ninguém a seu irmão:

versos.hebraico: בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שָׁנִים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַיּוֹבֵ֔ל תִּקְנֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁנֵֽי־תְבוּאֹ֖ת יִמְכָּר־לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
controles.kjv: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
controles.livre: Conforme o número dos anos depois do jubileu comprarás de teu próximo; conforme o número dos anos dos frutos te venderá ele a ti.

versos.hebraico: לְפִ֣י׀ רֹ֣ב הַשָּׁנִ֗ים תַּרְבֶּה֙ מִקְנָת֔וֹ וּלְפִי֙ מְעֹ֣ט הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תַּמְעִ֖יט מִקְנָת֑וֹ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר תְּבוּאֹ֔ת ה֥וּא מֹכֵ֖ר לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
controles.kjv: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
controles.livre: Conforme a abundância dos anos aumentarás o preço, e conforme a diminuição dos anos diminuirás o preço; porque segundo o número dos rendimentos te há de vender ele.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֤א תוֹנוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־עֲמִית֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You shall not wrong one another; but you shall fear your God: for I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: E não engane ninguém a seu próximo; mas terás temor de teu Deus: porque eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֙ אֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֔י וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֹתָ֑ם וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָבֶֽטַח׃

controles.web: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
controles.kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
controles.livre: Executai, pois, meus estatutos, e guardai meus regulamentos, e ponde-os por obra, e habitareis na terra seguros;

versos.hebraico: וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ פִּרְיָ֔הּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם לָשֹׂ֑בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
controles.kjv: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
controles.livre: E a terra dará seu fruto, e comereis até fartura, e habitareis nela com segurança.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ מַה־נֹּאכַ֤֖ל בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑ת הֵ֚ן לֹ֣א נִזְרָ֔ע וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱסֹ֖ף אֶת־תְּבוּאָתֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase”;
controles.kjv: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
controles.livre: E se disserdes: Que comeremos no sétimo ano? eis que não temos de semear, nem temos de colher nossos frutos:

versos.hebraico: וְצִוִּ֤יתִי אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי֙ לָכֶ֔ם בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑ית וְעָשָׂת֙ אֶת־הַתְּבוּאָ֔ה לִשְׁלֹ֖שׁ הַשָּׁנִֽים׃

controles.web: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
controles.kjv: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
controles.livre: Então eu vos enviarei minha bênção no sexto ano, e fará fruto por três anos.

versos.hebraico: וּזְרַעְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁמִינִ֔ת וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם מִן־הַתְּבוּאָ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ן עַ֣ד׀ הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַתְּשִׁיעִ֗ת עַד־בּוֹא֙ תְּב֣וּאָתָ֔הּ תֹּאכְל֖וּ יָשָֽׁן׃

controles.web: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
controles.kjv: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
controles.livre: E semeareis no ano oitavo, e comereis do fruto alheio; até o ano nono, até que venha seu fruto comereis do alheio.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִצְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי־לִ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֧ים וְתוֹשָׁבִ֛ים אַתֶּ֖ם עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
controles.kjv: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
controles.livre: E a terra não se venderá definitivamente, porque a terra minha é; que vós peregrinos e estrangeiros sois para comigo.

versos.hebraico: וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶ֑ם גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּתְּנ֥וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

controles.web: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
controles.kjv: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
controles.livre: Portanto, em toda a terra de vossa possessão, outorgareis remissão à terra.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָכַ֖ר מֵאֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ וּבָ֤א גֹֽאֲלוֹ֙ הַקָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֔יו וְגָאַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מִמְכַּ֥ר אָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
controles.kjv: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
controles.livre: Quando teu irmão empobrecer, e vender algo de sua possessão, virá o resgatador, seu próximo, e resgatará o que seu irmão houver vendido.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ גֹּאֵ֑ל וְהִשִּׂ֣יגָה יָד֔וֹ וּמָצָ֖א כְּדֵ֥י גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it;
controles.kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
controles.livre: E quando o homem não tiver resgatador, se alcançar sua mão, e achar o que basta para seu resgate;

versos.hebraico: וְחִשַּׁב֙ אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י מִמְכָּר֔וֹ וְהֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹדֵ֔ף לָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽכַר־ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
controles.kjv: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
controles.livre: Então contará os anos de sua venda, e pagará o que restar ao homem a quem vendeu, e voltará à sua possessão.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם לֹֽא־מָֽצְאָ֜ה יָד֗וֹ דֵּי֮ הָשִׁ֣יב לוֹ֒ וְהָיָ֣ה מִמְכָּר֗וֹ בְּיַד֙ הַקֹּנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיּוֹבֵ֑ל וְיָצָא֙ בַּיֹּבֵ֔ל וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee: and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.
controles.kjv: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
controles.livre: Mas se não alcançar sua mão o que basta para que volte a ele, o que vendeu estará em poder do que o comprou até o ano do jubileu; e ao jubileu sairá, e ele voltará à sua possessão.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יִמְכֹּ֤ר בֵּית־מוֹשַׁב֙ עִ֣יר חוֹמָ֔ה וְהָיְתָה֙ גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ עַד־תֹּ֖ם שְׁנַ֣ת מִמְכָּר֑וֹ יָמִ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.
controles.kjv: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
controles.livre: E o homem que vender casa de morada em cidade cercado, poderá resgatá-la até acabar-se o ano de sua venda: ano será o termo de se poder resgatar.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֣ם לֹֽא־יִגָּאֵ֗ל עַד־מְלֹ֣את לוֹ֮ שָׁנָ֣ה תְמִימָה֒ וְ֠קָם הַבַּ֨יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִ֜יר אֲשֶׁר־לא חֹמָ֗ה לַצְּמִיתֻ֛ת לַקֹּנֶ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָ֑יו לֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א בַּיֹּבֵֽל׃

controles.web: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.
controles.kjv: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
controles.livre: E se não for resgatada dentro de ano inteiro, a casa que estiver na cidade murada ficará para sempre por daquele que a comprou, e para seus descendentes: não sairá no jubileu.

versos.hebraico: וּבָתֵּ֣י הַחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵין־לָהֶ֤ם חֹמָה֙ סָבִ֔יב עַל־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב גְּאֻלָּה֙ תִּהְיֶה־לּ֔וֹ וּבַיֹּבֵ֖ל יֵצֵֽא׃

controles.web: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
controles.kjv: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
controles.livre: Mas as casas das aldeias que não têm muro ao redor, serão estimadas como uma plantação da terra: terão remissão, e sairão no jubileu.

versos.hebraico: וְעָרֵי֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בָּתֵּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אֲחֻזָּתָ֑ם גְּאֻלַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
controles.livre: Porém em quanto às cidades dos levitas, sempre poderão resgatar os levitas as casas das cidades que possuírem.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגְאַל֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְיָצָ֧א מִמְכַּר־בַּ֛יִת וְעִ֥יר אֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ בַּיֹּבֵ֑ל כִּ֣י בָתֵּ֞י עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֗ם הִ֚וא אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E o que comprar dos levitas, sairá da casa vendida, ou da cidade de sua possessão, no jubileu: porquanto as casas das cidades dos levitas é a possessão deles entre os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וּֽשְׂדֵ֛ה מִגְרַ֥שׁ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יִמָּכֵ֑ר כִּֽי־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ה֖וּא לָהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
controles.kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
controles.livre: Mas a terra dos arredores de suas cidades não se venderá, porque é perpétua possessão deles.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָ֥טָה יָד֖וֹ עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהֶֽחֱזַ֣קְתָּ בּ֔וֹ גֵּ֧ר וְתוֹשָׁ֛ב וָחַ֖י עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
controles.kjv: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
controles.livre: E quando teu irmão empobrecer, e se refugiar a ti, tu o ampararás: como peregrino e estrangeiro viverá contigo.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽאִתּוֹ֙ נֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֔ית וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְחֵ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God; that your brother may live among you.
controles.kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
controles.livre: Não tomarás juros dele, nem lucro; mas terás temor de teu Deus, e teu irmão viverá contigo.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֨ת־כַּסְפְּךָ֔ לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן ל֖וֹ בְּנֶ֑שֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּ֖ית לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן אָכְלֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
controles.livre: Não lhe darás teu dinheiro a juros, nem tua comida a ganho:

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ס

controles.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
controles.kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para vos dar a terra de Canaã, para ser vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָמ֥וּךְ אָחִ֛יךָ עִמָּ֖ךְ וְנִמְכַּר־לָ֑ךְ לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ד בּ֖וֹ עֲבֹ֥דַת עָֽבֶד׃

controles.web: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you; you shall not make him to serve as a slave.
controles.kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
controles.livre: E quando teu irmão empobrecer, estando contigo, e se vender a ti, não lhe farás servir como servo:

versos.hebraico: כְּשָׂכִ֥יר כְּתוֹשָׁ֖ב יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֑ךְ עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַעֲבֹ֥ד עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee:
controles.kjv: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
controles.livre: Como criado, como estrangeiro estará contigo; até o ano do jubileu te servirá.

versos.hebraico: וְיָצָא֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֣יו עִמּ֑וֹ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ וְאֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖יו יָשֽׁוּב׃

controles.web: then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.
controles.kjv: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
controles.livre: Então sairá de tua presença, ele e seus filhos consigo, e voltará à sua família, e à possessão de seus pais se restituirá.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לֹ֥א יִמָּכְר֖וּ מִמְכֶּ֥רֶת עָֽבֶד׃

controles.web: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.
controles.kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
controles.livre: Porque são meus servos, os quais tirei eu da terra do Egito: não serão vendidos à maneira de servos.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָ֑רֶךְ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
controles.livre: Não serás senhor dele com dureza, mas terás temor de teu Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְעַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיוּ־לָ֑ךְ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵהֶ֥ם תִּקְנ֖וּ עֶ֥בֶד וְאָמָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
controles.kjv: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
controles.livre: Assim teu servo como tua serva que tiveres, serão das nações que estão em vosso ao redor: deles comprareis servos e servas.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠גַם מִבְּנֵ֨י הַתּוֹשָׁבִ֜ים הַגָּרִ֤ים עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵהֶ֣ם תִּקְנ֔וּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹלִ֖ידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לַֽאֲחֻזָּֽה׃

controles.web: Moreover of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.
controles.kjv: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
controles.livre: Também comprareis dos filhos dos forasteiros que vivem entre vós, e dos que da linhagem deles são nascidos em vossa terra, que estão convosco; os quais tereis por possessão:

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְנַחֲלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֤ם אַחֲרֵיכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֲחֻזָּ֔ה לְעֹלָ֖ם בָּהֶ֣ם תַּעֲבֹ֑דוּ וּבְאַ֨חֵיכֶ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃ס

controles.web: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them may you take your slaves forever; but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.
controles.kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
controles.livre: E os possuireis por herança para vossos filhos depois de vós, como possessão hereditária; para sempre vos servireis deles; porém em vossos irmãos os filhos de Israel, não vos dominareis cada um sobre seu irmão com dureza.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֣י תַשִּׂ֗יג יַ֣ד גֵּ֤ר וְתוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וּמָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖יךָ עִמּ֑וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֗ר לְגֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ א֥וֹ לְעֵ֖קֶר מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת גֵּֽר׃

controles.web: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family;
controles.kjv: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
controles.livre: E se o peregrino ou estrangeiro que está contigo, adquirisse meios, e teu irmão que está com ele empobrecer, e se vender ao peregrino ou estrangeiro que está contigo, ou à raça da família do estrangeiro;

versos.hebraico: אַחֲרֵ֣י נִמְכַּ֔ר גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶה־לּ֑וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מֵאֶחָ֖יו יִגְאָלֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;
controles.kjv: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
controles.livre: Depois que se houver vendido, poderá ser resgatado: um de seus irmãos o resgatará;

versos.hebraico: אוֹ־דֹד֞וֹ א֤וֹ בֶן־דֹּדוֹ֙ יִגְאָלֶ֔נּוּ אֽוֹ־מִשְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖וֹ וְנִגְאָֽל׃

controles.web: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.
controles.kjv: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
controles.livre: Ou seu tio, ou o filho de seu tio o resgatará, ou o próximo de sua carne, de sua linhagem, o resgatará; ou se seus meios alcançarem, ele mesmo se resgatará.

versos.hebraico: וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
controles.kjv: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
controles.livre: E contará com o que o comprou, desde o ano que se vendeu a ele até o ano do jubileu: e há de estabelecer preço o dinheiro de sua venda conforme o número dos anos, e se fará com ele conforme o tempo de um criado assalariado.

versos.hebraico: אִם־ע֥וֹד רַבּ֖וֹת בַּשָּׁנִ֑ים לְפִיהֶן֙ יָשִׁ֣יב גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ מִכֶּ֖סֶף מִקְנָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
controles.kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
controles.livre: Se ainda forem muitos anos, conforme eles voltará para seu resgate do dinheiro pelo qual se vendeu.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־מְעַ֞ט נִשְׁאַ֧ר בַּשָּׁנִ֛ים עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל וְחִשַּׁב־ל֑וֹ כְּפִ֣י שָׁנָ֔יו יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.
controles.kjv: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
controles.livre: E se restar pouco tempo até o ano do jubileu, então contará com ele, e devolverá seu resgate conforme seus anos.

versos.hebraico: כִּשְׂכִ֥יר שָׁנָ֛ה בְּשָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יִרְדֶּ֥נּֽוּ בְּפֶ֖רֶךְ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
controles.kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
controles.livre: Como com tomado a salário anualmente fará com ele: não será senhor dele com aspereza diante de teus olhos.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל בְּאֵ֑לֶּה וְיָצָא֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֔ל ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֥יו עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee, he, and his children with him.
controles.kjv: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
controles.livre: Mas se não se resgatar em esses anos, no ano do jubileu sairá, ele, e seus filhos com ele.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־לִ֤י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבָדִ֔ים עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
controles.kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Porque meus servos são os filhos de Israel; são servos meus, aos quais tirei da terra do Egito: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
